title: Reading Drill — Tracking Litter after a Street Festival
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Tracking Litter after a Street Festival
passages.body:
**A** A volunteer team wanted to compare litter before and after a festival. Members cleared each survey strip on the morning before the event so old rubbish would not be counted with new items.

**B** Food wrappers were more common near places offering seating. The most distant area had mostly receipts, which were light enough to blow away from stalls.

**C** The team recommended moving two bins and adding signs near tables. It also proposed repeating the count after rain to see whether weather affected where paper collected.
